Central London Office Market Watch 28 August 2026 Article
Welcome to your latest Central London office market watch, exploring insight from the City and West End office occupational markets
As is often the case during the summer months, leasing activity moderated in July following an active end to Q2, although still remained at robust levels. 48 transactions totalling 719,623 sq ft took place across Central London, with the West End accounting for 53% of space acquired.
